slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. A line with no command word, such as a question, carries itself: its search terms are the line as asked. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

extent.instructions: Only when the action scrolls the page or a scrolling part of it: how far? Choose words when the words give a number of screens or pages; screen when they say nothing of how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as many screens as the number the words carry
options.little: a little: a third of a screen
options.screen: one screen, as Page Down does
options.end: all the way: to the bottom, or to the top going up

amount.instructions: Only when the action skips forward or back in a video or audio, changes its volume or speed, or changes an app number (a setting's amount, the panel's width): how far? For a skip, choose words when the words say how far — a number of seconds, or of minutes; otherwise the share of its length the words mean. For a volume, a speed or an app number, choose to when the words carry the level, else up or down and how far. Ignored for every other action.
